name: badge
description: The Energy fleet's auth domain-expert employee as one installable Claude Code plugin: bundles the `badge` CLI, the `badge` stdio MCP server, the four auth skills, the auth-lint hook, and the two sub-agent personas. Install to scaffold a real sign-in, classify any agent-auth task as P1-P4, audit OAuth/MCP configs, triage SAML/SSO, and plan provider migrations — enforcing intersection-not-union for agent authority. Powered by Energy.

hook.name: auth-lint
hook.description: Parse-time rejection of plain-PKCE / alg=none / wildcard redirect_uri / token-in-URL in staged auth code (KP-A2/F2/J2, OP O11).

install_instructions: Add this plugin to Claude Code: Settings → Plugins → Add local plugin → select the badge repo root. The `badge` CLI commands, the four auth skills, the two sub-agent personas (badge-provider-auditor, badge-migration-planner), and the auth-lint hook become available. The `badge` MCP server is wired via .mcp.json (env-ref tokens, no live keys) — run `pnpm build` first so dist/mcp/server.js exists.
